step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard visual shows an ingestion and distribution architecture for video advertising content. Content Originators and Media Outlets interact with AWS through an ELB protected by WAF (Firewall), or directly with S3. Traffic from ELB routes to an Application EC2 instance tier. The application offloads asynchronous processing jobs to SQS, which feeds into worker fleets (QC/Transcoding EC2 and Batch EC2). Processed media stored in S3 is distributed out to Media Outlets directly from S3 or via CloudFront CDN. Content Originators and Media Outlets are external actors. Standard AWS services mapped directly from the diagram include ELB, WAF, EC2 (App, QC Trans, Batch), SQS, S3, and CloudFront.

graph.name: Extreme Reach - Adbridge Media Distribution Architecture
graph.notes: Extreme Reach Adbridge platform uses S3, CloudFront, SQS, and EC2 fleets for video transcode, QC, and global ad delivery.
